# milestone 5: LLVM + crypto slice backlog

## purpose

The trackable **`M5-S-###`** slice backlog for milestone 5 (LLVM backend +
production crypto). The **definition of done**, scope decisions, macro phases
(P0–P5), and completion criteria live in the hub
**`task/sv0-toolchain-milestone-5-llvm-crypto.Rmd`**; per-epic engineering notes live
in the owning sub-tasks (`task/sv0c-*.Rmd`). This file is a **living index** — flip
status as slices land and keep it aligned with the hub's phase narrative.

## how to use

- Pick the next slice by macro phase (hub P0→P5); slices within a phase are roughly
  ordered by dependency.
- Each slice names its **owning sub-task**, an **acceptance** signal, and its
  **phase**. Add a one-line result + commit when a slice lands (like the M4 checklist).
- New `lib/*.sv0` (the LLVM emitter, std, crypto) joins the mega-TU + self-host
  loop — expect stage0/self-host golden refreshes on emitter/std slices.
- Keep the spec (`sv0doc`) aligned before claiming new crypto or LLVM-contract
  behavior.

### Epic A — LLVM IR emitter (`task/sv0c-llvm-backend.Rmd`)

New module `sv0c/lib/llvm_codegen.sv0`, mirroring `lib/codegen.sv0`'s `Instr` walk.
Strategy: **`alloca`-everything + `mem2reg`** (no hand-built φ-nodes); signedness lives
in the op, not the LLVM type (see hub design note 1).

| ID | slice | phase | status | acceptance |
|----|-------|-------|--------|-----------|
| M5-S-001 | `--target=llvm` dispatch + module skeleton | P0 | **todo** | CLI accepts `--target=llvm` (+ `--project`) in `lib/main.sv0`; emits `build/llvm/<stem>.ll` with module header + `target datalayout`/`triple` (open decision #2); an empty/`main`-only module `llvm-as` accepts. |
| M5-S-002a | type map — scalars | P0 | **todo** | `i8/u8→i8`, `i16/u16→i16`, `i32/u32→i32`, `i64/u64→i64`, `isize/usize→iPtr`, `bool→i1` (mem as `i8`), `unit→void`; width table shared with Epic D (`M5-S-030`). |
| M5-S-002b | type map — pointers / refs / string | P0 | **todo** | `&T`/`&mut T`→`ptr`; `string`/`str`→`ptr` (i8*); documented in `sv0c/doc/llvm-backend.md`. |
| M5-S-002c | type map — struct type decls | P0 | **todo** | each struct → named `%T = type { … }` in module preamble; field order matches the C/VM layout. |
| M5-S-002d | type map — enum tagged-union layout | P0 | **todo** | enum → `{ i32 tag, [payload] }` matching the VM `1 + maxPayload` slot model; tag encoding identical across backends. |
| M5-S-003a | fn signature + entry block + params | P1 | **todo** | `define` with mapped param/return types; entry-block `alloca` per param + `store` of the incoming value. |
| M5-S-003b | locals + `ret` / unit returns | P1 | **todo** | `alloca` per local; `ret <ty> %v`; `unit`/void returns as `ret void`; a no-arg `main` links + exits with the right code. |
| M5-S-004a | integer arithmetic | P1 | **todo** | `add/sub/mul`, `sdiv/udiv`, `srem/urem` chosen by signedness; matches C backend on the arithmetic corpus. |
| M5-S-004b | comparisons + boolean ops | P1 | **todo** | `icmp` (`slt/ult/…` by signedness) → `i1`; `and/or/xor` on `i1`; `!` as `xor …, true`. |

### Epic D — `std` foundation (`task/sv0c-std-foundation.Rmd`)

**Grounding (audit 2026-08-22):** fixed-width ints + bitwise/shift **already lower in
C and VM**; `::` paths + `Result`/`Option` already exist. So these slices *close tails
+ carry to LLVM + add coverage*, not add front-end features. See the hub grounding
audit.

| ID | slice | phase | status | acceptance |
|----|-------|-------|--------|-----------|
| M5-S-030 | fixed-width int **audit + width-normalize** | P0 | **todo** | confirm `i8…u64/isize/usize` widths across C+VM; fix `i32`/`bool`→ exact width where it matters; carry the width table into the LLVM emitter (`M5-S-002`); regression tests. No new front-end types. |
| M5-S-031 | bitwise/shift **coverage + LLVM + verifier hook** | P0 | **todo** | C+VM already lower `& \| ^ ~ << >>` — add LLVM emission (signed vs unsigned `ashr/lshr`, `sdiv/udiv`), grow the behavior corpus, and confirm the ops are extractable by Epic F (`M5-S-051`). |
| M5-S-032 | complete `[u8; N]` fixed arrays / buffers | P0 | **todo** | close the checker/lowering `TyArray` "unsupported" tails: decl, `ExprIndex`, `len`, bounds semantics, across C+VM+LLVM. **On the crypto critical path** (buffers). |
| M5-S-033 | `std::`/`crypto::` module **shipping + search path** | P1 | **todo** | resolver `::` already interns paths — add where library `.sv0` lives (leaning `sv0c/lib/std/`) + a driver search path + linking library TUs; `crypto::sha256::hash(...)` compiles + links end-to-end. Resolve open decision #3 first. |
| M5-S-034 | `std::bytes` + endianness/rotate helpers | P1 | **todo** | `rotl/rotr`, big/little-endian pack/unpack (endianness per open decision #2); unit + behavior tests. |
| M5-S-035 | fixed-width/bitwise/array `std` test corpus + docs | P1 | **todo** | grow beyond today's ~6 files to a real corpus (widths, wrapping, bitwise, arrays) + a `std` overview page; gated (test-suite bar). |
| M5-S-036 | wrapping/overflow arithmetic (`wrapping_add`, …) | P1 | **todo** | define + implement wrapping semantics (C signed overflow is UB today); gated across backends; matches LLVM `nsw/nuw` discipline; verifiable under QF_BV (`M5-S-054`). |

Ships as `std`/`crypto` sv0 source (Epic D `M5-S-033`). **Never hand-roll without
RFC/NIST vectors** — vectors live as data files under `sv0c/test/` with provenance
comments. API shapes in hub design note 5. Order: hash → MAC → AEAD → signature.

| M5-S-040d | SHA-512 KATs + streaming API | P4 | **todo** | NIST KATs + incremental parity. |
